idea-plugin.name: Marekov Easy Commit
idea-plugin.description:
Generates a commit message for your changes with a single click, using Claude through the Claude Code command line tool and your own Claude subscription.

How to use

  1. Open the Commit tool window and check the files you want to commit.
  2. Click the sparkle button next to the commit message history button.
  3. The generated message appears in the commit message field. Edit it if you like and commit.

Clicking the button again while the message is being generated cancels the generation.

Features

  • Messages in the Conventional Commits format, for example feat(lang): add Polish language followed by bullet points.
  • Uses only the files checked in the commit window, including new unversioned files.
  • Configurable model (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus), system prompt, timeout and maximum diff size in Settings | Tools | Marekov Easy Commit.

Requirements

  • Claude Code installed, with the claude command on your PATH, and logged in to your Claude account.
  • Developed and tested on Linux. macOS should work the same way; Windows support is experimental.

Privacy

To generate a message, the plugin sends the diff of the checked changes (text files only, up to the configured size) to Anthropic through your local claude command. Nothing is sent until you click the button. The plugin itself collects no data.
